name: refusal-monthly-day-of-month-past-thirty-one
note: A day of month past 31 is a PARSE error, not a month that never matches — so the whole rule refuses. Contrast the yearly Feb-30 case, which parses fine and legitimately fires nothing.
error: RRule("RRule parsing error: `32` is not a valid BYMONTHDAY value. Expected a comma-separated list of values in range -31..=31, e.g. `-30,10`")
